blog_hero_title: Step by step to healthy feet: all about podotherapy and podiatry
blog_hero_img_alt: Healthy bare feet by pool - sandals with removable footbed for insoles
blog_starter_intro: On this page you can find various interesting articles about foot health and podotherapy (sometimes called podiatry), along with other related topics. Here we share practical tips and useful insights to keep your feet happy and healthy. Whether it's finding the right shoes, understanding what podiatry and podotherapy can do for you, or simply learning to appreciate your feet, we have various interesting and informative articles to help you. Feel free to take a look and discover how to best care for your feet!
home_hero_img_alt: Feet in bed - podotherapy helps with foot complaints in Enschede
home_cta_title: Make an appointment online right away!
home_who_p1: We are a small-scale practice near the Zuiderval. We strongly believe in the power of a personal approach for successful treatment. Our practice is equipped with the latest technologies and methods, enabling us to make a good and specific diagnosis and offer a customized treatment plan, so you can move forward well again!
home_who_p2: We work together with other medical disciplines such as general practitioners, medical pedicurists and physiotherapists to provide the best care to our patients. Our practice is accessible to everyone - from children to active people with injuries and elderly with foot or foot-related complaints.
home_who_img_alt: Kim Bakhuis, podotherapist at VoorVoet Praktijk voor Podotherapie in Enschede
home_order_p1: An extra pair of insoles can be handy to use with a different pair of shoes, for example in your sports or hiking shoes. This not only saves the hassle of switching but also extends the lifespan of the insoles.
home_order_p2: An extra pair of insoles is only possible if you have been to VoorVoet before and we have a digital scan of your foot. If it has been longer than a year since you had a scan of your foot, it is advisable to schedule a check-up.
home_order_img_alt: Outdoor hiking shoes - suitable for podotherapeutic insoles
home_intro_p1: My name is Kim Bakhuis, podotherapist and owner of VoorVoet. In 2004 I graduated as a physiotherapist and after 3 years I came into contact with podotherapy. This profession appealed to me so much that I decided to retrain. I now have more than 16 years of work experience in this beautiful profession. In recent years I felt the urge and decided to set up my own practice in 2023.
home_intro_p2: Through my prior education, various training courses and years of experience, I have a broad view of foot and foot-related problems. It is important to be able to empathize well and do my utmost to help you as best as possible with your request for help. This can be in the form of advice, treatment and, where necessary, the manufacture of orthoses, nail braces or insoles. From my practical attitude, I like to work together with other disciplines to achieve the best result for you. In my private life, I am a very active person who enjoys hiking, running and Crossfit. I also like to challenge myself through cave diving and speleology trips.
home_intro_img_alt: Kim Bakhuis walking on the beach - active podotherapist in Enschede
home_info_card1_desc: Podotherapy (not podiatry, see our blog) treats various foot and foot-related complaints resulting from abnormal foot position. From nail complaints to lower back pain, and everything in between.
home_info_card2_desc: Want to know which foot complaints are best addressed at VoorVoet? On this page you'll find a brief overview of which complaints we can help you with.
home_info_card3_desc: We all want to know where we stand. That's why VoorVoet has created a handy searchable overview to see what reimbursement you're entitled to.
home_info_card4_desc: What does a visit to VoorVoet look like? What can you expect and what is important to know. We'd be happy to explain.
home_info_card5_desc: For hard workers who stand and walk a lot, foot complaints are especially annoying. Look here for more information about what we can do in the field of occupational podotherapy.
home_info_card6_desc: Everyone with foot or foot position-related complaints is welcome. From children with flat feet to adults and elderly with pain or walking problems.
home_locations_desc: VoorVoet has two practice locations in Enschede. Both locations are equipped with modern facilities and provide a professional environment for your treatment.
home_location1_desc: Our main location on Eeftinksweg offers all podotherapeutic treatments in a modern and accessible environment. The practice is easily accessible by car and has ample parking facilities.
home_location2_desc: Our second location on Beethovenlaan offers the same high-quality podotherapeutic care in a comfortable setting. Ample parking is also available here.
info_hero_subtitle: Everything you want to know about our treatments
info_hero_img_alt: Forest walk without foot pain thanks to podotherapy
info_what_p1: Podotherapy focuses on examining and treating complaints in the lower extremities. Think of foot complaints, but also complaints in knees, hips or the lower back. Do you experience pain? The podotherapist investigates the cause of your pain and then looks for the most suitable solution. This can be a custom-made insole, but also shoe advice, exercises, an orthosis, nail brace or a temporary treatment such as taping or applying felt. In short, for almost all complaints that are foot or foot position related, the podotherapist looks for a suitable solution.
info_what_img_alt: Skeleton of foot bones - podotherapy treats foot complaints
info_behandel_p1: We always start with a comprehensive intake to map out the complaints. Based on that, we conduct an examination. This usually consists of an inspection, examination of the gait pattern, a pressure measurement and testing the function of the feet. We also look at the footwear you walk in a lot or in which you experience many complaints. If a therapy is indicated, we discuss this together and with approval the therapy is started. In the case of fitting podotherapeutic insoles, the insoles are delivered in the short term and if you are new to us, a follow-up appointment always takes place. The therapy is always customized and tailored to the individual situation.
info_behandel_img_alt: Walking without foot pain thanks to podotherapy
info_risico_p1: A risk foot means that there are a number of factors present that increase the risk of developing wounds, and also all possible complications such as poor healing or even amputation. The risk factors for the development of these problems include sensory disturbances (neuropathy), reduced blood flow (angiopathy), reduced mobility and/or an abnormal foot position. This can lead to excessive pressure and friction, which can cause calluses, corns, blisters or wounds.
info_risico_p2: With reduced feeling in the feet, this is noticed less quickly or not at all. With poor blood flow, the wound will also heal poorly or not at all. A combination of these factors can lead to major problems and in extreme cases amputation. We naturally want to prevent that as much as possible.
info_risico_p3: There are many different causes for the development of neuropathy. This can be, for example, a neurological condition, or as a result of diabetes or rheumatism. It can also be a side effect of chemotherapy. These are just a few examples.
info_risico_img_alt: Athletic person with foot complaints and heel pain
info_risico_behandel_p1: If your primary care provider or practice assistant has referred you to VoorVoet Podotherapie Enschede due to a risk foot, the podotherapist will examine your feet for these risk factors. The risk factors will be mapped and if there is an increased risk, a personal treatment plan will be drawn up. This differs per person and can consist of foot care advice, shoe advice, fitting pressure-distributing insoles, manufacturing an orthosis or a combination of the above.
info_risico_behandel_p2: For foot treatments, close cooperation will be made with the medical pedicurist who will perform medically necessary foot care. We also work together with the practice assistant, general practitioner or specialist where necessary to keep your feet in the best possible condition.
info_risico_behandel_p3: From a certain risk classification you may be eligible for reimbursement from basic insurance. You need a referral from your primary care provider for this.
info_risico_class_intro: The risk classifications are called care profiles. Depending on the care profile, treatments are or are not reimbursed from basic insurance.
info_risico_level0_desc: There is no neuropathy or reduced blood flow - there is no increased risk - no reimbursement from basic insurance is possible. Your feet are - in that respect - in good condition!
info_risico_level1_desc: There is only neuropathy or reduced blood flow, but there are no pressure points - there is reimbursement for an annual foot examination at the podotherapist, but no reimbursement for treatments from basic insurance.
info_risico_level2_desc: There is neuropathy and reduced blood flow but there are no pressure points - there is reimbursement for treatments from basic insurance.
info_risico_level3_desc: There is neuropathy and/or reduced blood flow and pressure points are present - there is reimbursement for treatments from basic insurance.
info_risico_level4_desc: There is a wound in the past, an amputation or kidney function replacement therapy - there is reimbursement for treatments from basic insurance.
info_risico_reimb_text: Do you need podotherapeutic aids* to ensure that the foot position, foot function or pressure distribution under your feet improves? These are not covered by basic insurance. You may receive reimbursement from your supplementary insurance. Look for possible reimbursements of podotherapeutic aids in the
info_risico_reimb_footnote: (*) Podotherapeutic insoles, orthoses or nail braces are podotherapeutic aids used by VoorVoet Podotherapie Enschede.
info_klachten_intro: Below is a general list of complaints that are common in practice. Please feel free to contact us if you have any doubts or questions.
info_klachten_item1: Pain in the feet, heel pain, forefoot complaints, ankle complaints, tendon inflammations, excessive callus formation or corns, ingrown toenails.
info_klachten_item2: Foot deformities such as flat feet, hollow feet, collapsed (fore)feet, hammer or claw toes.
info_klachten_item3: Pain in the lower legs, knees, hips or back caused by problems with the feet or an abnormal foot position.
info_klachten_item4: Tired or painful feet and/or legs after standing or walking for a long time.
info_klachten_item6: Complaints as a result of diabetes, rheumatism or other conditions that affect the feet.
info_klachten_item7: Pain or discomfort during walking or sports.
info_klachten_img_alt: Foot anatomy with heel pain - VoorVoet podotherapy Enschede
info_bedrijf_title: Company podotherapy via VoorVoet podotherapie Enschede
info_bedrijf_intro: Company podotherapy is a specific form of podotherapy aimed at improving the health and well-being of employees. It focuses on preventing and treating foot complaints that arise from the work environment, such as wearing poorly fitting work shoes, prolonged standing on hard surfaces and repetitive tasks. If you have to stand and walk a lot for your work, this can naturally cause complaints.
info_bedrijf_includes_intro: Company podotherapy can be offered as part of a corporate health program and includes:
info_bedrijf_item1: Assessment of the work environment and work process
info_bedrijf_item2: Advice on wearing suitable shoes and, if necessary, fitting insoles that are suitable for work shoes. Specific laws and regulations apply to this.
info_bedrijf_item4: Exercises for the feet and improving posture
info_bedrijf_item5: Prevention of foot problems by improving the work environment and work process.
info_bedrijf_conclusion: Company podotherapy can help prevent and treat foot complaints and reduce absenteeism and associated costs. It can also contribute to improving employee productivity and satisfaction.
info_bedrijf_contact: Please contact us for more information without obligation.
info_bedrijf_img_alt: Employee with painful feet and heel pain - company podotherapy VoorVoet Enschede
info_everyone_intro: In every age category you can encounter different complaints. This can be related to development in children and changes in your body as you get older. So everyone can come to VoorVoet Podotherapie Enschede.
info_children_intro: Podotherapy can help improve the mobility and functioning of children's feet, which contributes to their overall health and well-being. It is important to start podotherapy in time if your child has foot problems, so that any conditions can be treated and prevented from worsening.
info_children_can_benefit: Children can benefit from podotherapy if they:
info_children_item1: Have problems with walking, running or jumping
info_children_item2: Experience pain or discomfort in the feet, legs, knees or back
info_children_item4: Have abnormalities of the legs or feet, such as knock knees or bow legs
info_children_item5: Wear out shoes quickly and excessively
info_athletes_title: Podotherapy for athletes and active people
info_athletes_intro: VoorVoet Podotherapie Enschede can provide a solution for athletes. Athletes can suffer from foot problems as a result of the many hours they spend hiking, running, jumping, running and other physical activities. Common foot complaints among active people include:
info_athletes_item1: Overload of the feet, causing inflammations, pressure problems, blisters or wounds.
info_athletes_item2: Sprains or strains of the feet.
info_athletes_item3: Stress fractures, caused by repeatedly loading the feet.
info_athletes_item4: Reduced mobility of the ankles and feet, which can affect performance.
info_athletes_conclusion: Podotherapy can help athletes and active people prevent and treat foot problems by improving mobility, adjusting shoes where necessary and/or providing exercises. Podotherapists can also advise and manufacture specific insoles or other aids that can improve performance and reduce the risk of injuries. Through proper care and advice, the podotherapist can ensure that you can stay fit and active.
info_elderly_intro: As an elderly person, you can also come to VoorVoet Podotherapie Enschede. As you get older, changes can occur in the feet, including:
info_elderly_item1: Thinning tissue, making the feet more sensitive.
info_elderly_item2: Loss of elastic resilience, making it harder for the feet to respond to load
info_elderly_item3: Osteoporosis, which contributes to the risk of fractures in the feet
info_elderly_item4: Diabetes, rheumatism, arthritis and other (chronic) conditions that can affect the functioning of the feet and make foot care more difficult. This poses an additional risk for the development of foot problems.
info_elderly_conclusion: Podotherapy can help optimize the pressure and support under the feet so that fewer pain complaints occur. This allows you to move more comfortably and safely, which reduces the risk of falling. It is important to seek help for foot problems in time, so that any conditions and pain complaints are treated in time and quality of life is improved.
